panel.description: Emojis any member of the server can use in messages and reactions, here and anywhere else on Linkord. The image is cropped to a square and stored at 128 px; GIFs stay animated.
panel.nameRule: Names: 2 to 32 lowercase letters, numbers or _.

deleteConfirm.title: Remove emoji?
deleteConfirm.description: :{{name}}: leaves the server. Old messages show it as text from then on.

errors.invalid_emoji_name: Names need 2 to 32 lowercase letters, numbers or _.
errors.invalid_image: Couldn't read that image. Use PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP.
errors.invalid_crop: The crop falls outside the image.
errors.emoji_too_large: That emoji comes out too heavy. Try a shorter animation.
errors.emoji_name_taken: There's already an emoji with that name in this server.
errors.emojis_full: The server has used all of its slots for that kind of emoji.

picker.hint: Hover over an emoji to see its name
